title: Sprint 2 – Database Optimization & Performance
description: Sprint Goal: Improve application performance by eliminating inefficient database operations and optimizing ORM queries.

tickets.title: Ticket 1 – Eliminate N+1 Query Problems
tickets.description:
Several APIs generate hundreds of unnecessary database queries due to improper ORM usage.

Expected Work
Identify N+1 query issues.
Optimize queries using select_related.
Optimize queries using prefetch_related.
Reduce total query count without changing functionality.
learning_objectives: Understand Ticket 1 – Eliminate N+1 Query Problems

tasks.title: Complete Ticket 1 – Eliminate N+1 Query Problems

tickets.title: Ticket 2 – Optimize Slow Dashboard APIs
tickets.description:
Dashboard endpoints take several seconds to load because of inefficient database operations.

Expected Work
Identify slow queries.
Optimize ORM logic.
Reduce execution time.
Improve overall API performance.
learning_objectives: Understand Ticket 2 – Optimize Slow Dashboard APIs

tasks.title: Complete Ticket 2 – Optimize Slow Dashboard APIs

tickets.title: Ticket 3 – Remove Duplicate Database Queries
tickets.description:
The same database queries are executed repeatedly within a single request.

Expected Work
Identify duplicate queries.
Reuse existing querysets.
Remove unnecessary database calls.
Improve response efficiency.
learning_objectives: Understand Ticket 3 – Remove Duplicate Database Queries

tasks.title: Complete Ticket 3 – Remove Duplicate Database Queries

tickets.title: Ticket 4 – Replace Python Loops with Database Operations
tickets.description:
Large datasets are processed using Python loops instead of efficient database aggregations.

Expected Work
Replace loops with ORM aggregations.
Use Count, Sum, Avg and annotations where appropriate.
Reduce processing time.
learning_objectives: Understand Ticket 4 – Replace Python Loops with Database Operations

tasks.title: Complete Ticket 4 – Replace Python Loops with Database Operations

tickets.title: Ticket 5 – Optimize Bulk Operations
tickets.description:
Thousands of records are inserted and updated individually, resulting in poor performance.

Expected Work
Replace repetitive save() calls.
Use bulk_create().
Use bulk_update().
Verify data consistency.

tickets.title: Ticket 6 – Fix Transaction Handling
tickets.description:
Multi-step operations leave the database in an inconsistent state when an exception occurs.

Expected Work
Identify unsafe database operations.
Use atomic transactions.
Roll back failed operations correctly.

tickets.title: Ticket 7 – Optimize Large Dataset APIs
tickets.description:
Some endpoints load complete tables into memory before processing results.

Expected Work
Optimize query execution.
Fetch only required records.
Improve memory usage.
Maintain existing functionality.
learning_objectives: Understand Ticket 7 – Optimize Large Dataset APIs

tasks.title: Complete Ticket 7 – Optimize Large Dataset APIs
